Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Looksy assistant character redesign concept. The user liked the tangible CGI rendering quality of an earlier proposal but rejected its camera-eyed optical-robot character design. Design a substantially different original character. Aim for the sophistication of a theatrical animated feature: appealing sculptural silhouette, believable dimensional anatomy, expressive acting, carefully groomed or authored surfaces, physically based material response, rich but controlled lighting, convincing contact shadows and weight. Full-body beauty render, one character only, three-quarter front view, square composition, entire silhouette and feet visible with safe margins, almost fills image. Seamless dark charcoal studio floor/backdrop. Large soft warm key, cool gentle fill, narrow soft rim. Character in sharp focus, natural portrait lens perspective. No text, logos, labels, panel borders, props, cameras, monitor faces, screen eyes, lens eyes, neon glow, scanlines, flat vector shading, outlines or recognizable existing movie characters. Personality should feel intelligent, observant, quietly funny, with an independent spark rather than babyish cuteness or a bland stock mascot.
Direction C — mechanical character with a new silhouette. An original small wiry but substantial workshop automaton, very different from a capsule camera robot. A low asymmetric sculpted head like a folded oval pebble with a distinct short projecting nose ridge, two small deeply inset expressive optical eyes with ordinary pupils (never a lens or a screen), articulated dark eyebrow plates, and an offset mouth seam capable of a restrained wry smile. The head hangs forward from a curved flexible neck into a small tapered torso. Long graceful jointed forearms, broad precise four-fingered hands, short springy bent legs, and oversized wedge-shaped feet give it an unmistakable attentive, slightly gangly silhouette with real balance. All limbs are modeled solid forms with purposeful bearings and soft protective cuffs, not wire sticks. Warm ivory satin enamel head/torso with clean sculpted curved panels, brushed dark titanium structural parts, charcoal elastomer joints, very restrained aged brass at bearings. Fine materials and clean controlled roughness; no scratched junkyard shell. It stands with knees softly bent, leaning forward with one hand raised at chest level and fingers slightly spread, as though carefully considering a visual composition. Confident curious personality, slightly eccentric, warm intelligent expression. No camera parts, lens face, TV head, antennas, chest lights, tools, props, greebles, generic rounded toy robot or resemblance to a specific existing animation character.
